about: God answers the boasting angels: transgressors will be held in chains until the great day, the faithful will sit at his right hand, and Satan can only suggest, never compel. The angels are then given flesh and descend to the daughters of Cain, whose offspring are giants (?), and God's wrath brings on the flood. Noah, who believes, is told to build an ark of wood, which the author reads as a figure of the Church and the Cross and ties to the Ark of the Covenant; the chapter closes with God's address, to Moses and through him to the people, calling them to sanctify themselves and seek the Ark.

sentences.l: And-when thus they-boasted said-to-them God, lover-of man: since-indeed-then you-erred by-transgressing word-my, your-wrong upon head-your; heat-of Gehenna and-fire and-ተይ(?) and-መርቄ(?) and-whirlwind your-dwelling until day great; you-shall-be-kept in-chains which-not are-loosed and-not are-broken, until for-ever;
sentences.i: And when they had boasted in this way, God, the lover of mankind, said to them, “Since you have erred by transgressing my word, the wrong is on your own heads: the heat of Gehenna, and fire, and ተይ (?), and መርቄ (?), and whirlwind will be your dwelling until the great day. You will be kept in chains that are not loosed or broken, forever;
sentences.n: This is God's reply to the angels' boast at the end of ch. 100a (“we are spiritual … he is earthly”). ወሶበ is ወ- 'and' + ሶበ 'when'; ተመክሑ is the tä-stem perfect 3rd plural of መከሐ 'boast'; ይቤሎሙ 'he said to them' (ይቤ + ሎሙ). መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of man' is the construct (as in መፍቀሬ ምሕረት in ch. 100a), God's regular epithet here. እምከመሰኬ is እምከመ 'since, once' (so elsewhere in this book, with a perfect: 'since you have erred') strengthened by -ሰ and -ኬ, 'since indeed, then'. በዐሊወ is በ- + the infinitive of ዐለወ 'pass over, transgress' (the angels' own word in 100a, ኢንትዐደው … ኢነዐሉ). ግፍዕክሙ ላዕለ ርእስክሙ, literally 'your wrong upon your head', is the Semitic idiom that the guilt falls on the doer (compare Ezekiel 33:4) (?). The doom is a list of nouns forming the subject of ምንባሪክሙ 'your dwelling' (ምንባር + ክሙ; ምንባሪ- is the stem before suffixes, as in ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን, ch. 45, 62). I take ሐረረት as 'heat' and ዐውሎ as 'whirlwind'. ተይ and መርቄ I leave untranslated (?): ተይ recurs in ch. 101 as a cosmic element beside fire, wind and water (ላዕለ እሳት ወተይ), and መርቄ is left unplaced in the published parts (ch. 35, 78); the grammar gives no sense for either, and the first draft's 'smoke' and 'gloom' were guesses. ትትዐቀቡ is the passive tä-stem imperfect 'you will be kept (guarded)'; ዘኢይትፈታሕ 'which is not loosed' (relative ዘ + ኢ + tä-stem); እስከ ለዓለም 'forever'. The 'great day' is the day of judgment (Jude 6).

sentences.l: and-if-indeed exactly you-kept word-my and-you-did commandment-my, you-shall-dwell at-right-hand-my and-at-left-hand-my;
sentences.i: but if you keep my word strictly and do my commandment, you will dwell at my right hand and at my left;
sentences.n: ወለእመሰ 'and if indeed' (ለእመ 'if' + -ሰ, contrasting with the doom above). ጥዩቀ 'exactly, strictly' is an accusative adverb (the same word as in the angels' plea 'test us strictly', 100a). ዐቀብክሙ and ገበርክሙ are 2nd plural perfects used for a future-sense condition ('if you have kept'); ትነብሩ 'you will dwell'. በየማንየ ወበፀጋምየ, 'at my right (hand) and at my left', is the place of honor and nearness (cf. Matthew 25:33–34; Mark 10:37).

sentences.l: for all who overcame was-strong, and-he-who-indeed was-overcome was-overpowered(?);
sentences.i: for everyone who conquers prevails, and whoever is conquered is overpowered (?);
sentences.n: A maxim that grounds the choice just offered. ሞአ 'conquer, prevail' and its passive ተመውአ 'be conquered' (ተ- prefix, the passive/reflexive stem); ኀየለ 'be strong' and ተኀየለ 'be overpowered'. The verbs of conquest are key words of the speech and return in unit 4 (ሞኦ ለኅሊና 'overcame the thought') and unit 11 (ሞአ …, ተመውኡ 'were overcome'). ተኀየለ is read as the passive of ኀየለ, 'was overpowered', by its parallel with ተመውአ (?); the published entry gives 'prevailed, grew strong' for the same form, which the glosser should broaden.

sentences.i: for Satan, too, has no power except only what he sows into the mind: he does not command, or compel, or strike, or drag, or seize, or dispute (?), but silently (?) he sows it into the mind;
sentences.n: እስመ ሰይጣንሂ 'for Satan too' (-ሂ 'also, even'). ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ 'except only'. ያሠርጽ is the causative (አ-stem) imperfect of ሠረጸ 'enter, spring up': 'he makes (a thought) enter, he plants'; ውስተ ኅሊና 'into the mind/thought'. The negated verbs ኢይኤዝዝ (አዘዘ 'command'), ኢያጌብር (አግበረ 'compel'; the long ጌ is unexpected, ያገብር being the regular form) (?), ኢይዘብጥ (ዘብጠ 'strike'), ኢይስሕብ (ሰሐበ 'drag'), ኢይእኅዝ (አኀዘ 'seize') are all imperfect 3rd masculine. ይትዋሣእ is the reciprocal (tä- with long ā) imperfect of the root of አውሥአ 'answer' (100a), hence 'answer back, dispute' (?); the first draft's 'take by force' had no support in the form. በጽምሚት 'in silence' (the published entry; also ch. 81, ቀበራሁ በጽምሚት) (?); 'secretly' is not given by the word. The teaching, that Satan only suggests and cannot compel, is the logic of the whole speech: the angels (and men) are responsible for yielding.

sentences.n: ዘተሠጥዎ is ዘ 'he who' + ተሠጥወ 'be persuaded, yield' (?; the verb is not attested elsewhere in the text, and its root, perhaps ሠጠወ 'draw, entice', is only a guess) + -ኦ 'it', literally 'who yielded to it', with ለኅሊና እኩይ 'to evil thought'. ይሬስዮ 'it makes him' (ረሰየ 'make, render' + -ዮ), ለሀጒል 'into destruction'. ሞኦ is the perfect of ሞአ + -ኦ ('overcame it'). ሞገሰ 'favor, grace'. ምዝጋና occurs nowhere else in the text; 'glory' (?) is a guess from the parallel with ሞገስ (flagged).

sentences.i: And as for you, as you have wished, let the mind of man and the flesh of man be upon you. But guard yourselves: do not transgress my word, or overstep my commandment, or defile yourselves, whether by food, or by drink, or by fornication, or by anything at all; do not pass beyond my word.” And then there were given to them, along with his word, flesh and blood and the heart of a human being, and they were sent forth (?) from the heights of heaven and came down (?) to earth, to the madness of the dancing (?) of the sons of Cain, with all their craft in which they busied themselves (?) in the madness of their fornication and singing, with drum and lyre and harp and much noise, with shouting and song;
sentences.n: The longest unit (58 words) and it has no ፤ at which to cut it, so I keep it whole as printed. It carries a turn: God's speech ends at ኢትዕድዉ እምቃልየ and the narrative of the angels' fall begins at ወሶቤሃ, so I close the quotation inside the unit. ወአንትሙኒ 'and you too'; በከመ ፈቀድክሙ ይኩን 'as you have wished, let it be' (jussive ይኩን 'let it be'): the sense is that they are given what they have chosen, a man's thought and flesh (?). ዑቁ is taken as the imperative plural of ዐቀበ 'keep, guard' (an irregular form, the plain imperative being ዕቀቡ; it occurs only here) (?) (ርእስክሙ 'yourselves', lit. 'your heads'); the prohibitions are ኢ- + 2nd plural imperfect, with the object ርእስክሙ after ኢታርኵሱ (አርኰሰ 'defile'); ኢበ- means 'not by'. ኢትዕድዉ is a form of ዐደወ 'pass over', as ኢትትዐደዉ at the start of the sentence. ተውህቦሙ 'was given to them' (ተወሀበ + ሙ); ልበ እጓለ እመሕያው 'heart of a human' (እመሕያው is እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living', as in the published entry, so the phrase is lit. 'offspring of the mother of the living', the Geʿez idiom for a human being). This is the story of Genesis 6:1–4 (the sons of God and the daughters of men), told here with the daughters of Cain's line. Readings I am unsure of: ተሠርሙ, which I take as 'were sent forth/cast out' (?) (its ending -ሙ is the pronoun 'them', as in ተውህቦሙ, not the plural ending of the perfect, so it may be an impersonal passive; it occurs nowhere else), and ወረዲ (?), which I take as a variant of ወረዱ 'they descended' (the same form, ወረዲ ውስተ ሲኦል ሕያዋኒሆሙ, stands in ch. 97 beside a plural subject) (the 3rd-order vowel is not the usual plural ending); ዘፍኖሙ from ዘፈነ 'sing, dance' (?) (cf. ይዘፍኑ ወይትዋነዩ, ch. 6) and እበደ as 'madness' (cf. ለእበድ in 100a); ኪኖሙ from ኪን 'art, craft' with ዘተኬነዉ 'which they practised' (?), the same verb as ተኬነወ in 100a unit 9 and unit 11 below, where the sense 'was zealous' is read (?); the glossary entry must cover all three. ኪን 'craft, skill' also occurs in በኪን ዘወሀቦ እግዚኣብሔር (ch. 25), so ተኬነወ may rather be 'worked skilfully, took pains' than 'was zealous' (?). Instruments: ከበሮ (drum), መሰንቆ (lyre), ዕንዚራ (harp), ረዓም (noise, thunder); ይባቤ 'shouting' (?) (cf. በውውዓ በትፍሥሕት ወበይባቤ among the instruments and acclamations of ch. 39).

sentences.i: and their daughters, too, were there and made merry without shame, for they were pleasing to them, and delighted them (?), and troubled their minds;
sentences.n: The women are the daughters of Cain's line named in unit 5. ወአዋልዲሆሙኒ 'and their daughters too'; ሀለዋ 'they (f.) were present'; ይትዋነያ 'they make merry' (tä-stem imperfect, 3rd feminine plural). ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame'. The three verbs are 3rd feminine plural perfects with the women as subject, like ሀለዋ: ተምዕዛ, አደማሆሙ (አደመ + -ኣ + ሆሙ 'them') and ሆካ, so ሆካ ኅሊናሆሙ is 'they disturbed their minds' (ኅሊናሆሙ the object; ሆከ 'disturb'). ተምዕዛ ሎሙ 'they were pleasing to them' is the tä-stem of መዐዘ 'be fragrant, sweet', as in ተሠነየት ወተምዕዘት ሎቱ 'she became fair and pleasing to him' (ch. 64). አደማሆሙ is አደመ 'please, be agreeable to' (አደመኒ አውሥኦትከ 'your answer pleased me', ch. 26; ኢይኤድሞ ለልብየ 'does not please my heart', ch. 36) + the feminine plural ending + ሆሙ 'them', so 'they pleased them' (?); the first draft's 'made them bloody' (from ደም) is dropped. The two verbs say that the women delighted the men, and ሆካ then says what that did to their minds.

sentences.i: For God does not rest in the heart of the proud and the slanderers, but rests in the heart of the humble and the simple; and in the Gospel, too, he spoke, saying, “Woe to those who justify themselves and despise their neighbors”;
sentences.n: A general principle supports the verdict on the angels who 'slandered' Adam (ሐመየ, 100a): the slanderers (ሐማይያን, plural of the agent noun ሐማይ) are lumped with the proud (ዕቡያን). ያዐርፍ 'rests' (አዐረፈ), the causative-stem verb used with God as subject; ትሑታን 'humble ones', የዋሃን 'simple, guileless ones' (plural adjectives). ወበወንጌልሂ 'and in the Gospel too': the reference is to the Gospel's teaching on self-justifying pride, Luke 18:9–14 (the Pharisee and the tax collector) and Luke 16:15, and 'woe' (አሌሎሙ) in the Gospels (e.g. Luke 6:24–26); the wording is the author's own. ያጸድቁ ርእሶሙ 'they justify themselves' (lit. 'their heads'); ይሜንኑ 'they despise' (መነነ); ቢጾሙ 'their companions, neighbors'.

sentences.i: as the Apostle said about his angels: “In their great sinning (?) he did not spare them, but set them in judgment, and they were bound for the great day”;
sentences.n: A citation of an apostle (singular ሐዋርያ, the Apostle). It rests on 2 Peter 2:4 ('God spared not the angels that sinned … reserved unto judgment') and Jude 6 (angels 'kept in everlasting chains … unto the judgment of the great day'); I name both because the Geʿez does not say which, and the words are the author's own. ኢመሐኮሙ 'he did not spare them' (መሐከ + -ሙ; the verb is found nowhere else in the book, and the printed ኮ may stand for ሮ, መሐረ 'have mercy, spare') (?); አንበሮሙ 'he set them' (አንበረ); ወተአስሩ 'and they were bound' (passive tä-stem of አሰረ). አቢሶሙ is the infinitive of አበሰ 'sin' (አቢሶ, the same pattern as ዐቂበ, ክሒደ, ዐሊወ in 100a) + -ሙ 'their', 'their sinning', with ጥቀ 'exceedingly'; I take the clause as causal, 'in their great sinning he did not spare them' (?). I mark the Apostle's words as a quotation.

sentences.n: ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር: ቃለ has the accusative/construct ending, so strictly the verb has no stated subject and 'the word of God' is its object ('[he] overcame the word of God'). I keep 'the word of God prevailed' because the next clause has the slanderers 'overcome' (ተመውኡ, echoing the rule of unit 2), but the case ending is against it (?). ዘተኬነወ በልሕኵቱ አዳም: ልሕኵት is a 'moulded thing, creature' (ለሐከ; ልሕኵትየ in 100a unit 9, ልሕኵቱ in ch. 60, ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the first of God's moulded things' of Adam in ch. 64), not 'weakness'; so 'zealous for his moulded creature, Adam', with ተኬነወ as in 100a unit 9 (እስመ ተኬነወ እግዚኣብሔር በእንተ አዳም) (?). እለ ሐመይዎ 'those who slandered him' (ሐመየ + -ዎ; same word as ዘሐመይዎ in 100a), ተሳለቁ 'mocked' (ተሳለቀ). እለሰ ተስሕቱ ቦቶን 'those who erred through them (f.)': ቦቶን anticipates አዋልደ ቀየን, and መላእክት is the antecedent in apposition; the daughters of Cain are the subject of ፀንሳ. The grammar of the women is feminine plural throughout: ፀንሳ 'they conceived', ስእና ወሊደ 'unable to bear' (ስእነ 'be unable' + infinitive), ሞታ 'they died'. ቦእለ is ቦ 'there are' + እለ 'those who' ('some who'). ሠጢቆሙ is the infinitive of ሠጠቀ 'split' (cf. ባሕረ ኤርትራ እንተ ተሠጥቀት, ch. 55) + -ሙ 'their', 'their splitting the womb of their mother'; ወፅኡ እንተ ሕንብርቲሆን 'came out by their navels' (እንተ read as 'by way of', otherwise the relative 'which') (?); ሕንብርቲሆን 'their navels'. The offspring are the giants of the next unit (compare Genesis 6:4).

sentences.n: ተሐፅኑ 'they were reared' (passive of ሐፀነ 'nurse'); ኮኑ ረዐይተ 'they became …'. ረዐይተ I translate as 'giants' (?) because of the relative clause 'whose height reaches to the clouds' (ኑኆሙ 'their height', ይበጽሕ 'reaches'); the form looks like a plural of ረዓይ 'shepherd', which would not make sense here, so this is from context only; elsewhere ረዐይ- is 'tend, shepherd' (ch. 98 ሥልሰ ረዐይኬ አባግዕየ) (?). ዘበእንቲአሆሙ 'on account of them'; አነኀ መዐቶ 'he prolonged his wrath' (causative of the root of ነዋኅ 'long' and ከመ ይኑኅ መዋዕሊክሙ 'that your days be long', ch. 90; ኑኆሙ 'their length, height' is the same root) (?). sentences.n: The faithful ('those who believed') are Noah's family. አምኑ 'they believed', ገብሩ 'they did' (3rd plural perfects). አልቦ ዘረከቦሙ እኩይ 'there was nothing that found them, evil' (ረከበ 'find, befall'). The saying turns to the singular (አመንከ 'you believe', ትክል 'you will be able'), addressed to Noah, and the next units then give his answer. ለእመ 'if' + a perfect gives a conditional; ድኂነ is the infinitive of ድኅነ 'be saved'.

sentences.i: When God gave the command, rather than giving him a wing like an eagle's, and carrying him across to the land of the living with all his house until he should cool his wrath against the sinners who do not believe the word of God and the word of their fathers; or rather than lifting him up into the air; or rather than commanding the waters of the flood to be like a wall, so that they would not come near one mountain where he would set Noah and his sons and those he wished, beasts and livestock, so that they would not bury them —
sentences.n: This unit (about 49 words, with no ፤ at which to cut it) is one long subordinate sentence whose main clause is the next unit. Its pattern is ሶበ አዘዘ 'when he commanded', then four times እም- + perfect + ኦ 'rather than his having …' (እምወህቦ, እምአዕደዎ, እምአዕረጎ, እምአዘዞ): 'rather than giving him … rather than bringing him across …'; ወህቦ is the perfect ወሀበ + ኦ with እም- ('than that he gave him'). ክንፈ ከመ ንስር, 'a wing like an eagle', recalls Exodus 19:4 ('I bore you on eagles' wings'); ብሔረ ሕያዋን 'land of the living' (Psalm 27:13, 52:5); ያቈርር 'he cools' (the causative አቈረረ of ቈረረ 'be cold', not the simple stem; the published entry; cf. ያቈርር መዐቶ, ch. 62). አዕደዎ 'he brought him across' (አዕደወ) and አው 'or'. ከመ አረፍት: አረፍት is a noun, 'wall' (the published entry; ቆመ ማይ ከመ አረፍት 'the water stood like a wall', ch. 17; አረፍት በይምን ወአረፍት በፅግም 'a wall on the right and a wall on the left', ch. 55), so 'that the water of the flood be like a wall', as at the Jordan and the Red Sea; the first draft's verb reading is dropped; ከመ ኢይቅረባ 'that they (f.) not approach' and ከመ ኢይድፍኖሙ 'that it not bury them' (ደፈነ 'cover, bury'); ለአሐቲ ደብር 'one mountain'. The sense is: why did God not use some wonderful means? (Genesis 6–8.)

sentences.i: “And I will sanctify it for you, in her (?), the work of my hands, heavenly and spiritual. And you also, sanctify yourself from abomination (?), and uncleanness, and fornication, and grudge, and falsehood, together with your brother and your house; and, pure with pure (?), sacrifice to me; and I will receive it from you (?) after you have sanctified yourself and your house. Command all the people to sanctify themselves, for my holy things are with the holy ones;
sentences.n: God speaks in the first person from here to the end of the part. The singular 'you' is Moses: unit 24 has God commanding Moses (ለሙሴ … ይግበር), the speech slips from that reported command into direct address, ምስለ እኁከ 'with your brother' fits Aaron, and አዝዞሙ ለኵሉ ሕዝብ 'command all the people' is the formula of ch. 90 (ወይቤሎ ለሙሴ አዝዞሙ) and the published entry reads it as 'addressed to Moses'; from ወለእመ መጻእክሙ the plural 'you' is the people. Noah, the 'you' of units 14–19, is not addressed here (?). በይእቲ 'in her' presumably the ark, which is feminine; እቄድሶ 'I will sanctify him/it' is masculine, so the object is perhaps the wood (?). ሰማያዊት መንፈሳዊት 'heavenly, spiritual' as in the preceding chapters, where the true ark in heaven is the model of the earthly one (cf. Hebrews 8:5, Exodus 25:40). ቀድስ ርእሰከ 'sanctify yourself' (imperative; ርእሰከ 'your head' = 'yourself'); the list ግምንና (?; unattested elsewhere) ወርኵስ ወዝሙት ወቂም ወሐሰት 'abomination, uncleanness, fornication, grudge, falsehood' are all objects of the preposition እም-. ወንጹሕ በንጹሕ ሡዕ ሊተ: ሡዕ is the 2nd singular imperative of ሠውዐ 'sacrifice' (ሡዕ ሊተ ወልድከ, ch. 12; ይሡዕ ሊተ, ch. 46; the published entry), not a noun; ወንጹሕ በንጹሕ 'pure with pure' I take as what is pure, by what is pure, i.e. clean gifts from clean persons (?). ወአነ እትዌከፍ ለከ 'and I will receive from you' (እትዌከፍ, from ተወከፈ); ቅድሳትየ በቅዱሳን 'my holy things (are) with the holy', cf. Leviticus 19:2, 1 Peter 1:16.

sentences.i: seek this, then: the ark of my covenant, which I created for my glory. And if you come with a pure heart, in love and in peace, without quarrelling (?) or slandering one another, and set your hearts right toward me and toward your neighbor, I will hear your prayer, and I will give ear (?) to your petition in all that you have entreated of me (?). And I will come and be with you, and I will walk among you, and I will dwell in your hearts;
sentences.n: The printed ኣፀምእ is the first-person imperfect ኣጽምእ, 'I will give ear' (from አጽምአ), with the ኣ initial (?); the usual verb for 'give ear' is spelled with ዐ (አጽምዐ), so the -እ may be a spelling variant (?). ዘንተኬ 'this, then' (ዘንተ + -ኬ). ተኀሥሥ is 2nd singular (not plural; the published entry parses it as the imperfect 'you search'), and I translate it as an imperative 'seek' (?). ታቦተ ኪዳንየ 'ark of my covenant', in the construct, and እንተ ፈጠርክዋ 'which I created her' (relative እንተ + ፈጠርኩ + ዋ 'her'). ወለእመ መጻእክሙ 'and if you come' (ለእመ + perfect). ተቃጽቦ and ተሓምዮ are tä-stem reciprocal verbal nouns ('one another'): ተሓምዮ 'slandering one another' (from ሐመየ, the word of the angels in 100a), ተቃጽቦ 'striking one another' (from ቀጸበ), 'quarrelling' by sense (?); አርታዕክሙ 'you set right' (from ርትዐ 'be straight'; the causative). ዘተጋነይክሙ ሊተ: ተጋነየ is a verb of prayer in this text (ኢጸለዩ ኀቤሁ ወኢተጋነዩ ወኢሰአልዎ, ch. 6; ወሰአሉ ወተጋነዩ ወበፅዑ ለእግዚኣብሔር, ch. 62; Noah ተጋነየ ወሦዐ ወጸውዐ, ch. 9), so 'supplicate, entreat'; 'what you have entreated of me' (?). Echoes: Leviticus 26:11–12, Ezekiel 37:27, 2 Corinthians 6:16; ወኣንሶሱ is 'I will walk about' (ነሶሰወ, the published lemma; ወኣንሶሱ ማእከሎሙ again in ch. 106). The split አኀ ድር is printed so; I read it as አኀድር 'I will dwell' (1st singular imperfect of ኀደረ, spelled so in ch. 1 and 106), and also keep the printed spacing in the text.

sentences.i: And you will be my people, and I will be your God in righteousness.”
sentences.n: The promise of the covenant formula ('You shall be my people and I will be your God', Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 7:23; Ezekiel 37:27) closes God's address. ትከውኑኒ 'you will be to me' (ትከውኑ + -ኒ, 'to me'; the -ኒ here is the dative pronoun, not 'also'); እከውነክሙ 'I will be to you' (እከውን + -ክሙ); በጽድቅ 'in righteousness'. The nine ፨ marks printed at the end close the paragraph (the whole of this part is one paragraph); they stay on this last unit as in earlier parts.

glossary.ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
glossary.ሞቱ: ሞት — his death (noun + -ሁ 'his') · ሞተ — they died (3mp perfect, G, m-w-t; ቦእለ ሞቱ 'some died')
glossary.ሞአ: ሞአ — he overcame, prevailed (3ms perfect, G, m-w-ʾ; in ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር the case of ቃለ leaves the subject uncertain) (?)
glossary.ሞኦ: ሞአ — he overcame it (3ms perfect, G, m-w-ʾ + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ሠጢቆሙ: ሠጠቀ — their splitting (infinitive of ሠጠቀ 'split' + -ሙ '3mp their'), 'as they split (the womb)'
glossary.ሥጋ: ሥጋ — flesh, body (noun; construct 'flesh of') · 'meat' as food (ከመ ይብልዓ ሥጋ 'to eat meat'; ነሥአ ሥጋ 'took meat') · his body, with -ሁ (ሥጋሁ)
glossary.ረከበ: ረከበ — he found, came upon (3ms perfect, G, r-k-b; who finds whom is left open (?))
glossary.ረዐይተ: ረዓይ — giants (?) (plural ረዐይት, accusative ረዐይተ; elsewhere ረዓይ is 'shepherd', ch. 98, so 'giants' rests on the context only) (?)
glossary.ረዓደ: ረዓድ — dread, trembling, terror (?) (noun, construct 'dread of', before ሲኦል)
glossary.ርብዕተ: ርቡዕ — square, four-sided (adjective, fem. accusative ርብዕተ) (?)
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ሰዐተ: ሰዐት — hour (noun, fem., accusative; after አሐተ 'one')
glossary.ሰይጣንሂ: ሰይጣን — Satan too, even Satan (noun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
glossary.ቅድሳትየ: ቅድሳት — my holy things, my holiness (noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.በልሕኵቱ: ልሕኵት — for his moulded creature (በ- + noun 'moulded thing, creature', from ለሐከ, + -ሁ '3ms his'; ልሕኵትየ in ch. 100a) (?)
glossary.በማየ: ማይ — with the water of (በ- + construct plural ማያት/ማየ)
glossary.በርባዔ: ርባዔ — by fourfold shape, four-sidedness (በ- + noun) (?)
glossary.በሰናስል: ሰንሰለት — in chains (በ- + noun, plural ሰናስል)
glossary.በቃለ: ቃል — by the word of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — with the holy ones (በ- + plural noun/adjective ቅዱሳን)
glossary.በእበደ: እበድ — in the madness of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዐሊወ: ዐለወ — by transgressing, by passing beyond (በ- + infinitive of ዐለወ)
glossary.በዕፅ: ዕፅ — with wood (በ- + ዕፅ 'wood, tree', noun)
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በየማንየ: የማን — at my right hand (በ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.በይእቲ: ይእቲ — on that, in that (በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative 'she, that')
glossary.ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))
glossary.ቦቶን: በ — through them, by them (preposition በ- 'by, through' + -ቶን '3fp them')
glossary.ቦእለ: ቦ — there are those who (existential ቦ 'there is' + relative እለ, run together)
glossary.ተመክሑ: ተመክሐ — they boasted, glorified themselves (3mp perfect, Gt, m-k-ḥ)
glossary.ተመውአ: ተመውአ — he was defeated (3ms perfect, Gt, m-w-ʾ)
glossary.ተምዕዖሙ: ተምዕዐ — he was angry with them (3ms perfect, tä-stem, m-ʿ-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them'; the person takes the accusative)
glossary.ተምዕዛ: ተምዕዘ — they (f.) were pleasing, sweet (3fp perfect, tä-stem of መዐዘ 'be fragrant, sweet'; ተምዕዘት ሎቱ 'she was pleasing to him', ch. 64)
glossary.ተስሕቱ: ተስሕተ — they erred, went astray (3mp perfect, Gt, s-ḥ-t)
glossary.ተስሕትክሙ: ተስሕተ — you erred, went astray (2mp perfect, Gt, s-ḥ-t)
glossary.ተቃጽቦ: ተቃጸበ — striking one another, quarrelling (?) (verbal noun of the reciprocal tä-stem, from ቀጸበ 'strike') (?)
glossary.ተኀሥሥ: ኀሠሠ — you search, examine (2ms imperfect, G, ḫ-ś-ś) · 'seek!' (2ms, imperfect used as a command; ዘንተኬ ተኀሥሥ ታቦተ ኪዳንየ 'seek, then, the ark of my covenant') (?)
glossary.ተኀየለ: ተኀየለ — he prevailed, grew strong (3ms perfect, ተ- stem, ḫ-y-l) · 'was overpowered' (ወዘሰ ተመውአ ተኀየለ 'whoever was overcome was overpowered', read as the passive of ኀየለ against ተመውአ) (?)
glossary.ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትትዐቀቡ: ተዐቀበ — you will be kept, guarded (2mp imperfect, Gt passive, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ትነብሩ: ነበረ — they sit, dwell (G imperf. in ትነብሩ, 2mp form after እለ though 3mp ይነብሩ is expected) (?) · 'you (2mp) will dwell' (ትነብሩ በየማንየ 'you will dwell at my right hand')
glossary.ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
glossary.ትእዛዝየ: ትእዛዝ — commandment (noun, singular, possibly collective; from አዘዘ; + -የ 'my', 1cs)
glossary.ትክል: ክህለ — you can (2ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
glossary.ትድኅን: ድኅነ — you will be saved (2ms imperfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ኀረዩ: ኀረየ — they chose (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀየለ: ኀየለ — he was strong, prevailed (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-y-l)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኃጥ: ኃጥእ — sinner (first part of the word printed split as ኃጥ ኣን, i.e. ኃጥኣን 'sinners')
glossary.ነሥኡ: ነሥአ — they took, received (3mp perfect) · take! / let them take (?) (the vowelling is that of the 3mp perfect, but the sense seems imperative or hortative, cf. ንሥኡ; ሕዝበ እስራኤል may then be a vocative; ነሥኡ መንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ... ሕዝበ እስራኤል) (?)
glossary.ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word, a matter' (ንንግርከኑ ነገረ 'may we tell you a matter?'; ch. 53) · ነገረ — he spoke, said (3ms perfect, G, n-g-r; ነገረ እንዘ ይብል 'he spoke, saying')
glossary.ኑኆሙ: ኑኅ — their length, height (noun, from ነኅ 'be long', + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.አሌሎሙ: አሌ — woe to them (interjection አሌ + -ሎሙ 'to them', 3mp)
glossary.አልባቢክሙ: ልብ — your hearts (noun, plural አልባብ, stem አልባቢ- + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አልቦሙ: አልቦ — they have not, there is not for them (negative existential + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አመንከ: አምነ — you believe (2ms perfect, G; conditional after ለእመ)
glossary.አመንኩ: አምነ — I believed (1cs perfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.አሚነ: አሚን — faith, belief (noun, accusative; from አምነ 'believe') (?)
glossary.አረፍት: አረፍት — wall (?) (noun; uncertain, perhaps 'heap') · 'wall' (ከመ አረፍት 'like a wall'; ቆመ ማይ ከመ አረፍት 'the water stood like a wall', ch. 17; አረፍት በይምን ወአረፍት በፅግም 'a wall on the right and a wall on the left', ch. 55)
glossary.አቅርንተ: ቀርን — horns (noun, plural አቅርንት; construct 'horns of')
glossary.አቢሶሙ: አበሰ — their sinning (infinitive አቢሶ, of the pattern ዐቂበ, + -ሙ '3mp their'; አቢሶሙ ጥቀ 'their sinning exceedingly') (?)
glossary.አነኀ: አነኀ — he prolonged (?) (3ms perfect, causative, from ነኅ 'be long'; አነኀ መዐቶ 'he prolonged his wrath') (?)
glossary.አንስትያ: ብእሲት — women (plural አንስት, here with accusative ending -ያ)
glossary.አንበሮሙ: አንበረ — he made them dwell (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem of ነበረ 'sit, dwell', + -ሙ '3mp them') · 'he set them' (ውስተ ደይን አንበሮሙ 'he set them in judgment')
glossary.አዋልደ: ወለት — daughters of (noun, plural አዋልድ, construct)
glossary.አዝዞሙ: አዘዘ — command them! (2ms imperative, G, addressed to Moses, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አድኀኖሙ: አድኀነ — he saved them (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ኢመሐኮሙ: መሐከ — he did not spare them (ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; the verb is found nowhere else in the book, and ኮ may stand for ሮ, መሐረ 'have mercy, spare') (?)
glossary.ኢበመብልዕ: መብልዕ — not by food (ኢ- + በ- + noun, from በልዐ 'eat')
glossary.ኢትትዐደዉ: ተዐደወ — do not pass by (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, tä-stem of ዐደወ 'cross, pass over')
glossary.ኢትዕድዉ: ዐደወ — do not pass beyond (ኢ- + 2mp jussive, G, ʿ-d-w)
glossary.ኢየአምኑ: አምነ — they do not believe (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ኢያዐርፍ: አዐረፈ — he does not cease, does not rest (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative; ብካየ 'weeping' and ወአንብዐ 'tears' are its objects)
glossary.ኢይቅረባ: ቀርበ — that they (f.) not approach (ኢ- + 3fp jussive ይቅረባ, G, q-r-b; the subject is the waters)
glossary.ኢይንበር: ነበረ — let it not remain, dwell (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ኢይድፍኖሙ: ደፈነ — that it not bury them (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, d-f-n + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ኣን: ኃጥእ — -ኣን, second part of the word printed split as ኃጥ ኣን, i.e. ኃጥኣን 'sinners' (plural ending)
glossary.እመልዕልተ: መልዕልት — from the height, the upper part (እም- + noun; construct 'height of')
glossary.እመሕያው: እመሕያው — mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
glossary.እምቃልየ: ቃል — from my word (እም- 'from' + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.እምአዕረጎ: አዕረገ — rather than he lifted him up (እም- + 3ms perfect, causative of ዐርገ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.እምአዘዞ: አዘዘ — rather than he commanded it (እም- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.እምከመሰኬ: እምከመ — since indeed, since then (conjunction እምከመ 'since, once' + enclitic -ሰ + -ኬ)
glossary.እምወህቦ: ወሀበ — rather than he gave him (እም- 'rather than' + 3ms perfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; spelled ወህቦ)
glossary.እምውእቱ: ውእቱ — from that (እም- + pronoun ውእቱ '3ms he', used as demonstrative 'that')
glossary.እሰምዐክሙ: ሰምዐ — I shall hear you (1cs imperfect, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እቄድሶ: ቀደሰ — I shall sanctify it (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.እበደ: እበድ — folly (noun; construct 'folly of') · 'madness' (እበደ ዘፍኖሙ 'the madness of their dancing (?)')
glossary.እትዌከፍ: ተወከፈ — I shall receive (1cs imperfect, tä-stem, w-k-f)
glossary.እኁከ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ከ 'your', 2ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እዴየ: እድ — my hand(s) (noun + -የ '1cs my'; 'work of my hands')
glossary.እድኅን: ድኅነ — I shall be saved (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.እጓለ: እጓል — offspring, sons of (noun; construct 'offspring of'; እጓለ እመሕያው 'human beings')
glossary.እፈክር: ፈከረ — I shall explain, interpret (1cs imperfect, G, f-k-r)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ከርሦንሂ: ከርሥ — their (f.) womb also (noun + -ሆን '3fp their', here -ኦን + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ኪኖሙ: ኪን — their craft, skill (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; cf. በኪን, ch. 25) (?)
glossary.ክንፈ: ክንፍ — wing (noun, accusative) · fin (ክንፍ 'wing, fin'; ክንፈ ወቅሣረ 'fin and scale')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)' · 3ms used with a feminine subject, ኮነ ሚጦተ 'became a turning' said of the rod (then ኮነት) (?)
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ወሆካ: ሆከ — and they troubled, disturbed (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, h-w-k)
glossary.ወለቢጽክሙ: ቢጽ — and to your neighbour (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወለኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and to all of them (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወለደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' marking the object + plural ደቂቅ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.ወሊደ: ወለደ — to beget (infinitive / verbal noun, accusative, w-l-d; after ሰአነ 'be unable') · 'to bear, give birth' of the women (ስእና ወሊደ 'unable to bear')
glossary.ወልበ: ልብ — and the heart (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወሐማይያን: ሐማይ — and slanderers (ወ- + plural of the agent noun ሐማይ, from ሐመየ)
glossary.ወመርቄ: መርቄ — and ? (ወ- + word unidentified, evidently a land-type or place) (?) · beside fire, ተይ and whirlwind among the torments of Gehenna: sense unknown, left untranslated (?)
glossary.ወማሕሌቶሙ: ማሕሌት — and their song, hymnody (ወ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወሞታ: ሞተ — and they (f.) died (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G)
glossary.ወሥጋ: ሥጋ — and flesh (ወ- + noun; construct 'flesh of')
glossary.ወርኵስ: ርኵስ — and uncleanness, impurity (ወ- + noun/adjective ርኩስ 'unclean')
glossary.ወስእና: ስእነ — and (they were) unable (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G; followed by infinitive ወሊደ)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወሶቤሃ: ሶቤሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
glossary.ወበመሰንቆ: መሰንቆ — and with the lyre (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበረዓም: ረዓም — and with noise, thunder (ወ- + በ- + noun) (?)
glossary.ወበሰላም: ሰላም — and in peace (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበወንጌልሂ: ወንጌል — and in the Gospel also (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወበዕንዚራ: ዕንዚራ — and with the harp (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበፀጋምየ: ፀጋም — and at my left hand (ወ- + በ- + noun 'left' + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወባእ: ቦአ — and enter! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወቤትከ: ቤት — and your house (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወቦእለ: ቦ — and there are those who (ወ- + ቦ 'there is' + relative እለ, run together)
glossary.ወተሐፅኑ: ተሐፅነ — and they were reared, nursed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ሐፀነ)
glossary.ወተሓምዮ: ተሐምየ — and slandering one another (ወ- + verbal noun of the reciprocal tä-stem, from ሐመየ 'slander') (?)
glossary.ወተመውኡ: ተመውአ — and they were overcome (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt, m-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተሠርሙ: ተሠርመ — and they were sent forth (?) (ወ- + tä-stem perfect; -ሙ is probably the pronoun 'them' on an impersonal 3ms passive, otherwise read as 3mp; the verb is not attested elsewhere) (?)
glossary.ወተሳለቁ: ተሳለቀ — and they mocked (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem of ሳለቀ)
glossary.ወተአስሩ: ተአስረ — and they were bound (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt passive of አሰረ)
glossary.ወተይ: ተይ — and ? (ወ- + word unidentified; a cosmic element or torment beside fire, cf. ላዕለ እሳት ወተይ in ch. 101; sense unknown, left untranslated) (?)
glossary.ወትከውኑኒ: ኮነ — and you will be to me (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, k-w-n + -ኒ '1cs to me')
glossary.ወአምነ: አምነ — and he believed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወአርታዕክሙ: አርትዐ — and you set right, straighten (ወ- + 2mp perfect, causative, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ወአሰሮሙ: አሰረ — and he bound them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአበሱ: አበሰ — and they sinned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ʾ-b-s)
glossary.ወአኀ: ኀደረ — and I shall dwell (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, first part of ወአኀድር, printed split as ወአኀ ድር)
glossary.ወአኅለቆሙ: አኅለቀ — and he destroyed them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአንተኒ: አንተ — and you also (ወ- 'and' + 2ms independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአዋልዲሆሙኒ: ወለት — and their daughters also (ወ- + plural አዋልድ + -ሆሙ '3mp their' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአይድዐኒ: አይድዐ — and tell me! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative, y-d-ʿ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአደማሆሙ: አደመ — and they pleased them (?) (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, ʾ-d-m 'please, be agreeable to' as in አደመኒ 'it pleased me', ch. 26, + -ሆሙ '3mp them') (?)
glossary.ወኢበመስቴ: መስቴ — and not by drink (ወ- + ኢ- + በ- + noun, from ሰትየ 'drink')
glossary.ወኢበዘኮነ: ዘ — and not by anything at all (ወ- + ኢ- + በ- + relative ዘ + 3ms perfect ኮነ 'it was'; lit. 'by what it was')
glossary.ወኢበዝሙት: ዝሙት — and not by fornication (ወ- + ኢ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወኢተዐገሱ: ተዐገሰ — and they did not endure (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, Gt, ʿ-g-s)
glossary.ወኢታርኵሱ: አርኰሰ — defile (2mp jussive, causative stem; ኢ- negative; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወኢትዕልዉ: ዐለወ — and do not overstep (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp jussive, G, ʿ-l-w)
glossary.ወኢያጌብር: አግበረ — and he does not compel (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ገብረ; the long ጌ is irregular, ያገብር being expected) (?)
glossary.ወኢይሰበር: ሰበረ — and is not broken (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, here passive in sense 'be broken') (?)
glossary.ወኢይስሕብ: ሰሐበ — and he does not drag (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, s-ḥ-b)
glossary.ወኢይትዋሣእ: ተዋሥአ — and he does not dispute, answer back (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem with long ā, w-ś-ʾ; from the root of አውሥአ 'answer'; the sense 'take by force' is not supported by the form) (?)
glossary.ወኢይኤዝዝ: አዘዘ — and he does not command (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-z-z; ይኤዝዝ is the regular imperfect of an ʾ-initial root)
glossary.ወኢይእኅዝ: አኀዘ — and he does not seize (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ወኢይዘብጥ: ዘብጠ — and he does not strike (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, z-b-ṭ; ወዘይዘብጥ ቢጾ 'whoever strikes his neighbour', ch. 90)
glossary.ወኣንሶሱ: ነሶሰወ — and I walk about (ወ- + 1cs imperfect of the four-radical verb; written ኣንሶሱ, form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኣፀምእ: አጽምዐ — and I shall give ear (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, causative, ṣ-m-ʿ; the printed ኣፀምእ is spelled with እ for ዐ) (?)
glossary.ወእሄሉ: ሀሎ — and I shall be, be present (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, ሀለወ)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእመጽእ: መጽአ — and I will come (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወእምአዕደዎ: አዕደወ — and rather than he carried him across (ወ- + እም- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኦ '3ms him') (?)
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወእከውነክሙ: ኮነ — and I shall be to you (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G + -ክሙ '2mp to you')
glossary.ወወረዲ: ወረደ — and they came down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G; the ending -ዲ for -ዱ also in ወረዲ ውስተ ሲኦል, ch. 97) (?)
glossary.ወዕፀ: ዕፅ — and wood, tree (ወ- + noun: accusative in ወዕፀ ዘኢይነቅዝ ጸሊመ 'and wood that does not rot, black', construct 'wood of' in ወዕፀ ቄድሮስኒ 'and cedar wood')
glossary.ወዘሰ: ዘ — and whoever, indeed (ወ- + relative ዘ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘተሠጥዎ: ተሠጥወ — and he who yields to it (ወ- + ዘ 'he who' + 3ms perfect, tä-stem, + -ኦ 'it', written -ዎ; the verb is not attested elsewhere, 'yield' is from the context) (?)
glossary.ወየዋሃን: የዋህ — and simple, guileless ones (ወ- + plural adjective)
glossary.ወያኀስሮሙ: አኀሰረ — and he causes them loss, diminishes them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ኀሰረ 'lack', + -ሙ '3mp them'; cf. ያኀስር, ch. 99)
glossary.ወይሜንኑ: መነነ — and they despise (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, m-n-n)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይትዋነያ: ተዋነየ — and they made merry, sang together (ወ- + 3fp imperfect, tä-stem III, w-n-y)
glossary.ወይከውኖ: ኮነ — and it will be to him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-w-n + -ኦ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወድኅነ: ድኅነ — and he was saved (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ወገበርክሙ: ገብረ — and you did (ወ- + 2mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
glossary.ወጽርባ: ጽርባ — and ? (ወ- + word unidentified, a further description of the ark, perhaps its shape or its coating (Genesis 6:14 'pitch'); left untranslated) (?)
glossary.ወፅኡ: ወፅአ — they went out (3mp perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ውሣጥያተ: ውሣጢ — compartments, inner rooms (noun, plural ውሣጥያት, accusative ውሣጥያተ) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዐቀብክሙ: ዐቀበ — you kept, guarded (2mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዐባይ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; spelled ዐባይ, taken as a variant spelling) (?)
glossary.ዑቁ: ዐቀበ — guard! take heed! (2mp imperative; irregular spelling, the plain form being ዕቀቡ) (?)
glossary.ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘሞአ: ሞአ — who overcame, conquered (ዘ + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-ʾ)
glossary.ዘረከቦሙ: ረከበ — which befell them (ዘ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ዘበእንቲአሆሙ: በእንተ — on account of them (ዘ + preposition በእንተ with -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘተቀደሰ: ተቀደሰ — which was sanctified, made holy (ዘ + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀደሰ)
glossary.ዘተኬነወ: ተኬነወ — which was zealous for, took up the cause of (?) (ዘ + 3ms perfect, tä-stem; as ተኬነወ in ch. 100a; perhaps rather 'worked skilfully, took pains', cf. ኪን; sense from context only) (?)
glossary.ዘተኬነዉ: ተኬነወ — which they practised, busied themselves with (?) (ዘ + 3mp perfect, tä-stem; the same verb as ተኬነወ in ch. 100a, 'took up the cause of, was zealous for'; here read with ኪን 'craft' as 'worked at'; sense from context only) (?)
glossary.ዘተጋነይክሙ: ተጋነየ — that which you entreated (?) (ዘ + 2mp perfect, tä-stem, g-n-y; a verb of prayer in ch. 6, 9, 62) (?)
glossary.ዘንተኬ: ዝንቱ — this indeed (accusative ዘንተ + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘኢይትፈታሕ: ተፈትሐ — which is not loosed (ዘ + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, Gt passive, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame')
glossary.ዘዘ: ዘዘ — each, every (distributive, ዘ doubled; ዘዘ ዓመት 'each year')
glossary.ዘያሠርጽ: አሠርጸ — that which he sows, causes to enter (ዘ 'that which' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ሠረጸ 'enter', ś-r-ṣ)
glossary.ዘፍኖሙ: ዘፈን — their dancing (?) (noun, from ዘፈነ 'dance, sing', ch. 6, + -ሙ '3mp their'; genitive after the construct እበደ) (?)
glossary.ዝ: ዝ — this (demonstrative, masc. sg.; ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.ያሠርጽ: አሠርጸ — he sows, causes (a thought) to enter (3ms imperfect, causative of ሠረጸ 'enter', ś-r-ṣ)
glossary.ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ያቈርር: አቈረረ — he cools, makes cold (3ms imperfect, causative of ቈረረ)
glossary.ያነብሮ: አንበረ — he would set him (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, causative of ነበረ + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ያዐርፍ: አዕረፈ — rest, come to rest (3ms imperfect, A stem used intransitively; cf. ወአዕረፈ in ch. 42)
glossary.ያዐብዩ: አዐበየ — they exalt, magnify (3mp imperfect, causative, ʿ-b-y)
glossary.ያጸድቁ: አጽደቀ — they justify (3mp imperfect, causative, ṣ-d-q)
glossary.ያፈቅሮሙ: አፍቀረ — he loves them (3ms imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሬስዮ: ረሰየ — it makes him, brings him to (3ms imperfect, G, r-s-y + -ዮ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቀድሱ: ቀደሰ — let them sanctify (3mp jussive, G)
glossary.ይበጽሕ: በጽሐ — he/it reaches (3ms imperfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ድር: ኀደረ — -ድር, second part of ወአኀድር 'and I shall dwell', printed split as ወአኀ ድር (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ድኂነ: ድኅነ — to be saved (infinitive ድኂን, accusative; ትክል ድኂነ 'you can be saved')
glossary.ገህነም: ገሃነም — Gehenna, hell (noun; genitive after the construct ሐረረት)
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈቀድክሙ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2mp perfect, G)
glossary.ፈጠርክዋ: ፈጠረ — I created her (1s perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ዋ 'her')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
glossary.፻ወ፳: ፻ወ፳ — 120, spoken ምእት ወዕሥራ (məʾət wä-ʿəśra) 'one hundred and twenty' (numeral)
